ana: Run-of-show & slides: https://redwood.app/s/allhands_oct18 (internal)

devbot: Reminder: calendar invite created: Oct 18 09:30 PT — All-hands (Q4 roadmap + AMA) — https://calendar.redwood/ev/3210

ana: We'll include a 90s incident TL;DR in Eng's slot and a short slide listing gating metrics. If you have a sensitive question, DM me or use #exec-private.

ana: Pre-meeting action list:
• Product (marcus): attach GA gating metrics + sample progress cadence
• Eng (sylvie): 90s TL;DR + RCA bullets + link to postmortem
• CS: draft customer comms template for GA and retention policy note

marcus: I'll attach the gating doc and propose a weekly status email cadence by Wed.

sylvie: RCA summary uploaded to run-of-show; will mark which fixes are prod vs staging.

ana: Key messages we want to land:
• Clear pass/fail criteria for Dedicated GA and a transparent status cadence

• Customer comms template and support expectations for launch

ana: Please keep Qs short and in-thread. We'll curate a small list to kick off the AMA. Thanks all — see you Fri 9:30 PT. :rocket:
